name: Side Panel
author: gshulga
description: A configurable edge side panel that hosts plugin pages and launches standard Omarchy panels.

barWidget.description: An edge side panel for secondary plugins

schema.label: Side panel edge
schema.description: The screen edge from which the side panel opens.

schema.label: Side panel layout
schema.description: Overlay windows or reserve screen space while the side panel is open.

schema.label: Reveal at screen edge
schema.description: Open Side Panel when the pointer rests at its configured edge.

schema.label: Edge reveal delay (ms)
schema.description: How long the pointer must remain at the configured edge before Side Panel opens.
